card.name: Historical and cultural themes in general web text
card.fires_on: Words in web passages about history, heritage, period architecture or style, and cultural representation, often at a verb or linking word just before a history-related noun. It is strongest where the text turns to cultural imagery, such as Native mascots or period décor.

modes.label: Cultural imagery and mascots
modes.description: Verbs or prepositions in text about retiring or using Native caricatures and mascots.
modes.example: Schools, districts and even state boards of education have voluntarily<< retired>>  caricatures of Native peoples and traditions

modes.label: Period styles and history
modes.description: Words in text about historic architecture, period interiors or history readers, such as neo-Gothic or Neoclassical.
modes.example: In the 19th century many of the Baroque additions were removed and replaced by<< neo>>-Gothic details.

modes.label: Zoo or exhibit locations
modes.description: The word at before an institution name in zoo or aquarium news.
modes.example: and is the third sloth born<< at>> National Aquarium.

card.writes: It pushes toward historical-era and cultural-period words such as medieval, Colonial and Viking, and away from theme-park, hotel and brand words.
card.plain: It marks passages about history, heritage and period style, where a historical-era word is likely to come next.
